snippet.title: Dishonored VR Mod - Preview
snippet.description:
Blood, sweat and Tears over the last 3 weeks. I've been working on a Dishonored VR Mod. It still has a way to go before I'm comfortable with a public release. But I have true Stereo, Decoupled Arms, hand/motion control aiming for weapons and Magic, and 6DOF Leaning and crouching. 
If you want to support the project I have a Pateron https://www.patreon.com/GingasVR  But the mod will be released for free. 

~~Twitch~~
https://www.twitch.tv/gingasvr 
~~TikTok~~
https://www.tiktok.com/@gingasvr?lang=en
~~Discord~~
https://discord.gg/7p5ZvP9pES
~~My Website~~
 https://gingasvrmods.com/
~Patreon~~
https://www.patreon.com/GingasVR 

Use this link to get awesome Kiwi Design stuff 
https://www.kiwidesign.com/?ref=eu5vbuagcz
You can also use the code gingas at the checkout for a discount!
